Additional details for Cursor support: this is still unresolved on my account as of September 20, 2026.

posts.name: Colin
posts.cooked:
Hi all,

Thanks for the reports. We’re aware of an issue where some Grok Bot Computers are failing to fully rehydrate during recreation. Most boxes appear to be coming up on their own eventually, so please check your Grok Bots again. In the meantime, we’re actively investigating and will share an update as soon as we have more information.
